gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes stating which stop rule actually governed the end of a rigid inclusion column's installation - design depth reached, or refusal. An as-built fact, distinct from the refusal criterion itself (a specification-side acceptance criterion cited by the construction activity, not a coded value). Used for the value of diggs:RIColumnConstructionType/diggs:terminationOutcome.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Rigid Inclusion Termination Outcome Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Installation stopped because the column reached the design toe depth or elevation, with no refusal criterion triggered.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Design depth reached

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Installation stopped because the specified refusal criterion (for example a penetration-rate or torque threshold) was met before the design depth was reached.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Refusal
